summary: Iter30 first-time-user UAT pass — backend warm-path 100% PASS, frontend 95% PASS with ONE CRITICAL BUG. Backend (curl + mongo): /api/health=ok/db up, /api/founders/status returns {cap:500, taken:0, remaining:500, open:true} pre-signup. Created a brand-new user via POST /api/auth/signup with referrer_id=Maggie — response carried is_founder=true, founder_number=1, badges includes 'Founding Member', points=55 (50 founder + 5 signup), invited_by=friendplace-v1 ✅. GET /api/users/<new_id> persists all fields. /api/founders/status flipped to taken=1, remaining=499 — confirms welcome banner copy switches correctly. Email-required validation enforced (422 when missing or weak password). /api/events 200, /api/tables 200 (Coffee Lounge surface). Frontend Playwright (mobile 390x844): welcome-brand renders, founder banner reads '499 Founding Member places remaining. / Free during testing.' (live counter shown because db had founders during test); welcome-apple count=0 on both / and /auth/welcome ✅; Sign Up → /auth/welcome → /auth/signup navigation flow works; signup-step-indicator shows '1 2 Step 1 of 2 — Account'; empty Continue triggers 'Username must be at least 3 characters' toast; /invite/<maggie_id> shows 'Margaret invited you to join YouBelong' headline, FounderBadge would render if Maggie were a founder (she is not in seed), 'Continue with Margaret's invite' CTA wired, AsyncStorage 'youbelong.invite.ref' set to Maggie's id (verified via localStorage on web). CRITICAL: Onboarding wizard 3-step trim is BROKEN — stepView mismatches the spec (see action_items below). Deprecation warnings noted: 'shadow*'/'textShadow*' style props + Image.style.resizeMode are RN-web platform warnings, not blocking. Cleanup: deleted 1 test user (uat_iter_*), 0 waitlist rows, 3 'Founding Member #1' notifications; verified 0 founders remain in db.

ui_bugs.issue: Step 2 of the trimmed 3-step wizard renders the AVATAR picker (Step3 view) instead of the Groups picker (Step4 view). stepView memo at /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:487 maps `case 1: return Step3` (PeopleAvatarPicker) and `case 2: return Step5`. Per PRD it should be Welcome → Groups → Destination, but the user actually sees Welcome → Avatar → Destination. Groups picker, joinAll CTA, and onb-join-all/onb-group-* testIDs are completely unreachable in the wizard. Fix: change `case 1: return Step3` to `case 1: return Step4`. Also the previously-collected interests aren't being persisted because the groups-load effect (useEffect at line 83 gated by `step !== 4`) will never trigger when step never reaches 4.

Footer `step === 4` skip/finish branches at /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:543 & :554 are dead code since totalSteps=3 (max step is 2). No user impact but should be cleaned up when fixing the stepView bug above.

issues: Inline error toast appears at the bottom but obscures the Continue button on a 390x844 viewport — works but visually busy. Cosmetic.

react_native_issues.issue: Console reports `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".` and `"textShadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "textShadow".` — emitted repeatedly from welcome/auth screens. RN-web has tightened the API; should switch to the new boxShadow / textShadow single-prop syntax to silence the warnings before launch.

Console: `Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.` Appears on /index.tsx hero image. Move `style={{ resizeMode: 'cover', opacity: 0.18 }}` to `contentFit`/`imageStyle` prop directly.

Console: `Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.` Fires on the toast slide-in. Web fallback works; consider gating `useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web'` to silence the warning.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix /app/frontend/app/onboarding.tsx:487 stepView mapping — `case 1: return Step3` must become `case 1: return Step4` so step 2 of the wizard renders the Groups picker (per the PRD'd Welcome → Groups → Destination flow). Without this fix the trimmed wizard silently swaps Groups for the Avatar picker that was supposedly removed.

After fixing the stepView, also fix the groups-loading useEffect gate at onboarding.tsx:83 — it's gated on `step !== 4` but in the new 3-step layout the groups step is `step === 1`. Suggested: introduce a constant (GROUPS_STEP=1) and use it in both the effect gate and the footer's skip-finish branch.
Clean up dead code at onboarding.tsx:543 and :554 — references to `step === 4` are unreachable with totalSteps=3.

Migrate `shadow*` and `textShadow*` style props to the new `boxShadow` / `textShadow` single-prop API across the codebase before launch (welcome/index, auth screens, ShareYouBelong, etc.) to silence the RN-web 0.74+ deprecation warnings.
Move `style.resizeMode` to `imageStyle`/`contentFit` on expo-image instances (e.g. /app/frontend/app/index.tsx ImageBackground at lines using resizeMode in style).
Consider gating animation `useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web'` in the toast component to silence the 'native animated module is missing' warning on web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6302+ lines — still over the 700-line guideline (raised in iter28 + iter29). Recommend splitting into routers/ per domain before launch promo.

Onboarding wizard stepView+effect were trimmed from 6→3 by re-using existing step JSX but the mapping wasn't validated end-to-end — exactly the kind of regression a fresh-user smoke would catch. Suggest adding a smoke playwright test that walks the wizard and asserts Step 2 shows a [data-testid^=onb-group-] node.
ShareYouBelong personalised URL correctly uses `/invite/<user_id>` (not the old `?ref=` form) — verified at /app/frontend/src/components/ShareYouBelong.tsx:73.
FounderBadge correctly returns null for non-founders, so Maggie's seeded profile (is_founder=false) won't accidentally surface the chip on the invite landing — graceful.

rca_of_issue: Onboarding regression RCA: When the wizard was trimmed from 6 → 3 steps the dev kept the step component constants (Step0..Step5) intact and only changed the totalSteps const + stepView switch. The switch maps step index 1 → Step3 (avatar picker) and step index 2 → Step5 (destination picker), which silently swapped the intended Groups picker (Step4) for the Avatar picker (Step3). Reproduction: log in as any user with onboarding_completed=false, navigate to /onboarding, press Continue once; you'll see 'Pick a profile picture' instead of 'Join a few groups'. Mitigation: change `case 1: return Step3` to `case 1: return Step4` on line 489 and update the groups-loading effect gate from `step !== 4` to `step !== 1`.
